title: Steven Greer cut the four-fingered arm from the 2000 Weygandt interview

tellings.quote: >> this was actually one of the things that Steven Greer cut out of their year 2000 interview.

plain: An online researcher who goes by UAPGerb says that Steven Greer, who in 2000 recorded witness interviews for a UFO disclosure campaign, cut a detail out of his interview with a witness named Jonathan Weygandt: a four-fingered arm. UAPGerb says this shows up in the raw files from Greer's archive and mentions the filmmaker James Fox in connection with it, and tells it because it would mean a key piece of testimony about a non-human body was left out.
